items.title: Make explicit-ledger invocation harder to misorder
items.evidence: The first dogfood wrapper failed when it placed --ledger before the subcommand. Fieldbook currently defines --ledger on subcommands, not as a top-level option. This phase updated README and agent-skill guidance; accepting --ledger before the subcommand remains deferred.
items.proposed_shape: Either document subcommand-scoped --ledger more prominently, or add a true global --ledger option accepted before the command.

items.title: Dashboard needs a locality and redaction presentation layer
items.evidence: Dogfood status and export payloads correctly included absolute local artifact paths under <LOCAL_LEDGER>. These are useful for agents but not suitable for shared dashboards.
items.proposed_shape: Dashboard queries should classify artifact URI locality and render private local paths through redacted labels or path basenames unless an operator explicitly opts into full local paths.
